Answer: Since $P(X>25.5)=0.26$, $P\left(Z>\frac{25.5-23.4}{\sigma}\right)=0.26$, so $\frac{25.5-23.4}{\sigma}=0.643$.
B1: $0.643\le z\le0.6435$, or $-0.6435\le z\le-0.643$, seen.

M1: $\pm$ standardisation formula with 25.5, 23.4 and $\sigma$, equated to a $z$-value (not $1-$ their $z$-value). Condone continuity correction $\pm0.05$; not $\sigma^2$ and not $\sqrt\sigma$.

Answer: $\sigma=3.27$.
A1: $3.26\le\sigma\le3.27$. Do not award for improper fractions.
